say:1:1530383001:1.text: No. I'm from a small, remote village, nothing like Halia.
say:1:1530383001:1.source_cn: 嗯。我的家乡是一个偏远的小村镇，可比呼临城小多了。

say:2:1530383002:1.text: It was a small place, but life was good. I thought I'd spend my whole life there.
say:2:1530383002:1.source_cn: 虽然那里很小，但我们过得也不错。说实话，我本来打算一辈...

say:3:1530383003:1.text: Then the bugs came and destroyed everything!
say:3:1530383003:1.source_cn: 但那些虫子来了，把我的家乡毁了个干净。

say:4:1530383004:1.text: So I fled here, to the great city of Halia. I figured only a big city like this could defend against monsters.
say:4:1530383004:1.source_cn: 所以我就逃来了这，传说中的呼临城。估计只有这种大城邦，...

say:5:1530383005:1.text: Maybe here I'll find a way to live. And if not... it doesn't matter. I've already lost everything.
say:5:1530383005:1.source_cn: 希望能在这找到活路吧。找不到也没事……反正我已经什么都...
